class.name: VirtualShadowPages
class.brief_description: CPU-side virtual shadow map page manager with clipmap levels, caster invalidation and an LRU page pool.
class.description: Each frame: call [method begin_frame], [method request_for_receivers] and optionally [method invalidate_casters], then [method end_frame] to resolve the requests against the physical pool. Clipmap levels are recentred by whole pages in global page coordinates, so cached pages stay valid across recentring. Static casters are never passed in, so their pages stay cached. The design follows publicly documented virtual shadow maps and the clipmap idea of Tanner et al. (1998).

method.name: get_levels
method.description: Returns the number of clipmap levels.

method.name: get_level0_size
method.description: Returns the world size of level 0.

method.name: get_page_size
method.description: Returns the page size in texels.

method.name: get_virtual_resolution
method.description: Returns the virtual resolution per level.

method.name: get_pages_per_axis
method.description: Returns the number of pages per axis and level.

method.name: get_physical_capacity
method.description: Returns the number of physical pages.

method.name: setup
method.description: Configures the manager and clears the cache.

method.name: level_world_size
method.description: Returns the world size covered by a level.

method.name: page_world_size
method.description: Returns the world size of one page at a level.

method.name: texel_world_size
method.description: Returns the world size of one texel at a level.

method.name: begin_frame
method.description: Starts a frame: rebuilds the light basis and recentres each clipmap by whole pages. A moved light marks every cached page stale.

method.name: clipmap_center
method.description: Returns the clipmap centre of a level in global page coordinates.

method.name: level_for_footprint
method.description: Returns the finest level whose texel size covers the receiver's pixel footprint.

method.name: request_for_receivers
method.description: Requests the pages needed by visible receivers. Points outside a level's window are skipped.

method.name: invalidate_casters
method.description: Marks cached pages overlapping moved caster [AABB]s dirty.

method.name: end_frame
method.description: Resolves requests against the pool and returns [code]{allocated, reused, rendered, evicted, dropped, requested, resident}[/code].

method.name: resident_count
method.description: Returns the number of resident pages.

method.name: is_resident
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a page is resident.

method.name: get_render_jobs
method.description: Returns the page render jobs from the most recent [method end_frame] as packed records of four integers: clipmap level, global virtual page X, global virtual page Y, and physical cache slot. Each newly allocated or dirty requested page produces one record in deterministic global-page-key order. Static, unchanged pages produce no jobs. The list is cleared by [method begin_frame] or [method setup]. A renderer can use the records to schedule shadow depth rendering; this class does not issue GPU draw calls itself. The existing [code]rendered[/code] statistic counts scheduled page renders and assumes the caller actually completes them before sampling the page table.

method.name: page_table
method.description: Returns a toroidal page table for shaders: [code]levels * pages_per_axis^2[/code] entries holding the physical slot or [code]-1[/code]. Index: [code]level*N*N + (gy mod N)*N + (gx mod N)[/code]. Only cached pages inside the CURRENT clipmap window may populate the table, preventing stale pages with the same modulo coordinates from overwriting visible mappings after camera movement. Cached pages outside the current window remain available for later reuse.
